title: Phase 2: Production-source architecture conformance
status_detail: Human response `recommendation authorized` selects and activates this Phase 2 Task for managed planning and four inactive implementation slices only. The subsequent exact human response `yes` to `Do you accept the Phase 2 planning/decomposition result? Acceptance will not activate an implementation slice.` is normalized as acceptance of this bounded planning/decomposition result. Phase 2 remains selected with status `planning`; the architecture parent, all four implementation children, and Phases 3-6 remain inactive. This planning acceptance does not activate implementation, authorize source, test, export, dependency, wire, or public-contract mutation, authorize staging, commit, or push, or establish software verification, numerical verification, scientific validation, or uncertainty quantification. That preserved text records the accepted planning/decomposition state at acceptance. Under the later exact human response `recommendation authorized`, Phase 2 moved to deferred between children while `python.architecture-refactor.architecture-conformance.production-facts` was separately selected and explicitly implementation-authorized. The subsequent exact response `accepted and authorized` human-accepts and closes that bounded child result and authorizes its administrative closeout; selection is cleared. The Phase 2 parent remains deferred between children and is not closed, the other three children remain inactive, and automatic successor activation remains false. Under the later exact human response `recommendation authorized`, `python.architecture-refactor.architecture-conformance.callable-private-rules` was separately selected and explicitly implementation-authorized. The subsequent exact response `yes` human-accepts and closes that bounded child result and authorizes its administrative closeout; selection is cleared again. Under the later exact human response `recommendation authorized`, `python.architecture-refactor.architecture-conformance.dependency-graph-views` was separately selected and explicitly implementation-authorized. The subsequent exact response `accepted and closeout authorized` human-accepts and closes that bounded child result and authorizes its administrative closeout; selection is cleared again. The Phase 2 parent remains deferred between children and is not closed; production-facts, callable-private-rules, and dependency-graph-views remain closed; ratchet-integration and Phases 3-6 remain inactive; automatic successor activation remains false.
objective: Plan explicit-input, read-only production-source architecture inspection and a controlled migration ratchet for the accepted Python architecture policy without authorizing implementation.
authorized_scope: Plan exact source facts and candidate policy checks for selected production architecture rules without ambient discovery, source mutation, automatic repair, or implementation under this planning status.

Treat supported-export agreement only as neutral syntactic export facts or agreement against an explicitly supplied accepted route contract; the 985 support dispositions remain Phase 3-owned and unclassified.
Require every candidate rule to identify exactly one of deterministic enforcement, deterministic structural observation, or review-only signal.
State that semantic ownership of public, scientific, numerical, comparison, compatibility, or validation policy is review-only absent explicit semantic metadata.
Preserve the accepted version-one `python.test-evidence` subject; a future production inspection capability is a sibling subject/profile, not a mutation of that accepted contract.
Record four inactive implementation slices for production facts, callable/private rules, dependency graph views, and ratchet integration, each requiring separate explicit activation.
completion_criteria: The Phase 2 contract states the neutral supported-export boundary, Phase 3 ownership of all 985 route dispositions, the three candidate-rule classifications, and the semantic-metadata review-only boundary.
The accepted version-one `python.test-evidence` subject remains unchanged and future production inspection is constrained to a sibling subject/profile.
Exactly four inactive child Tasks record the approved dependency DAG, precise authority, scope, completion criteria, and exclusions without granting implementation authority.

The operation-scoped ownership preflight, planning completion validator, configured formatting and typing checks, JSON assertions, Harness validation, projection reconstruction check, and whitespace check pass before independent review.
exclusions: No production implementation is authorized by the planning status, selection receipt, decomposition, or child records.

Do not classify or dispose of any of the 985 export routes, infer support from syntax, or mutate accepted public, scientific, numerical, comparison, compatibility, or validation policy without explicit semantic metadata and applicable authority.
Do not mutate the accepted `python.test-evidence` contract, rewrite source, auto-generate APIs, auto-repair or rename owners, or treat one dependency graph view as universally normative.
Do not change production source, tests, exports, dependencies, wire contracts, public contracts, Phase 1 reports or inventory, scientific behavior, protected execution, or publication content.
No staging, commit, push, release, child activation, Phase 3 activation, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
